args.code: (() => { const brand = document.querySelector('select'); if (!brand) return JSON.stringify({found:false}); const opts = [...brand.options].map(o=>({v:o.value,t:o.text})); brand.value = opts[1]?.v || opts[0].v; brand.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return JSON.stringify({found:true, selected: brand.value, options: opts.slice(0,8)}); })()
